label: GO step, confident a1 choice, early in the episode (trials < ~30)
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass) and almost only when the agent picks a1 (97% of mass; model_act==1). It is confined to early episode trials: about 47% of mass in trials 0-9, 43% in 10-19, 9% in 20-29, and none from trial 40 on (none on trials 0-1 either). Mass is concentrated where the a1 policy logit is large (choice > 8.07 holds 87% of mass). The predicate uses only the agent own choice logit and the trial index, no future variables. (phase==GO)&(action==1)&(ep_trial<30) gets recall 0.95 but precision 0.23; limiting it to a strong a1 logit and trial < 25 brings dev F1 to 0.52 (mass recall 0.86). Rates are mildly higher after unrewarded or rare previous trials and in episodes that started with S1 good (85% of mass), but neither clause made a clean improvement. Never fires at D1 or D2, on a2 choices (with rare exceptions), or late in the episode. Many early a1 GO steps stay inactive, so precision is incomplete: some per-episode state that was not identified gates it.
